name: Life Sucks Then you Die!
source:
The story is about an accident where you discover that each character leads a different life and witnesses their own personal tragedy. Can you save them – or not?

[From [url=https://kler143.itch.io/life-sucks-then-you-die]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述了一次意外，你发现每个角色都过着不同的生活，并见证了自己的个人悲剧。你能拯救他们吗——或者不能？

[来自[url=https://kler143.itch.io/life-sucks-then-you-die]Itch.io[/url]]
